title: Add Tidepool to objective question
symptom: The objective question in AndroidAPS may cause confusion because it seems to imply that Nightscout is no longer required, while Tidepool can be used as an alternative.
cause: The documentation states 'We recommend using Nightscout' which is a recommendation, not a requirement, leading to confusion.
fix: Update the documentation to clarify that Nightscout is a required prerequisite, or adjust the objective wording to avoid confusion.
evidence_quote: The documentation at https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/SettingUpAaps/SettingUpTheReportingServer.html clearly states "We recommend using Nightscout." - a recommendation, not a requirement.
